description:
In historic Hanyang, Kang Hansu turns to the law to make a living. An unconventional attorney in a land where convention rules all, Hansu is unafraid to take on seemingly unwinnable cases from clients…as long as they have the coin. But as he becomes embroiled in a scandal involving powerful forces that rule the land, the Joseon Attorney will have to band together with a unique cast of characters to ensure that his job - and his life - are safe from harm.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/comic/ep_list/joseon_b), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/54540469), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=4903964), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/joseon_lawyer)
